items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted File Upload via Guest Carts
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, named PolyShell by Sansec, allows unauthenticated attackers to upload disguised image files containing PHP code through the guest cart API, leading to remote code execution. It has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five critical ones, that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. It includes fixes for CVE-2026-103849 and CVE-2026-92909.

items.title: BlockStrap: Remote Code Execution via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: BlockStrap is a CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection. Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153, but new installations may still be vulnerable without a manual patch.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, with a CVSS score of 9.8, affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code due to an incorrect authorization flaw. It was addressed in the APSB26-153 security update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler Hotfix)
items.summary: This out-of-band security update resolves a critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-75650 (StyleSmuggler), that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Zero-Day Remote Code Execution under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Attacks started on September 4th, and Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7th.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, including six exploitable without authentication. These include two stored cross-site scripting flaws and an incorrect authorization flaw, which could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.
